meta.price_disclaimer: All values in price_estimate are non-binding estimates compiled for planning purposes only. They are not quotes, are not sourced from the venues, and change by season, day of week and party size. Every booking is confirmed and priced by the Riviera concierge team.
meta.image_disclaimer: Images are generated abstract plates, not photographs of the venues. Replace them with licensed photography before this is shown to guests.

items.name: Nammos
items.beschreibung: The island's most photographed beach club on Psarou, where lunch runs long and the champagne trolley never stops.
items.price_estimate: estimate: EUR 250-500 per person, sunbed minimum spend applies

items.name: Scorpios
items.beschreibung: A ritual-driven day club above Paraga bay that builds from long-table lunch to a drummed sunset set.

items.name: Principote
items.beschreibung: Panormos bay's white-on-white terrace, known for a Greek kitchen that outperforms its party reputation.

items.name: Alemagou
items.beschreibung: A bamboo-shaded Ftelia institution for guests who want the music without the bottle-parade.

items.name: Matsuhisa Mykonos
items.beschreibung: Nobu Matsuhisa's terrace at Belvedere, still the reference point for sushi on the island.

items.name: Interni
items.beschreibung: A courtyard restaurant in Chora that turns into one of the town's late bars after midnight.

items.name: Kastro's
items.beschreibung: The classic Little Venice sunset table, best booked for the hour before the light goes.

items.name: Cavo Paradiso
items.beschreibung: A clifftop open-air club above Paradise beach that only makes sense after 2am.
items.price_estimate: estimate: EUR 80-120 entry, tables from EUR 1,500

items.name: Void Club
items.beschreibung: A dark, sound-first room in Chora booking harder techno than the beach circuit.
items.price_estimate: estimate: EUR 40-80 entry, tables from EUR 800

items.name: Cavo Paradiso Table & Bottle Service
items.beschreibung: A reserved table on the cliff terrace with a dedicated host and bottles on arrival, so nobody queues.
items.price_estimate: estimate: tables from EUR 1,500, magnum service from EUR 900

items.name: Scorpios Sunset Table
items.beschreibung: A held table for the sunset set with bottle service, the hardest seat on the island to get on the day.

items.name: Delos & Rhenia Private Charter
items.beschreibung: A full-day motor yacht run to the Delos ruins and the swimming bays of Rhenia, crew and lunch aboard.
items.price_estimate: estimate: EUR 2,500-6,000 per day for the boat

items.name: Sunset Sail to Armenistis
items.beschreibung: A smaller sailing yacht for the golden hour off the lighthouse, drinks and mezze aboard.

items.name: Jet Ski Safari, Kalafatis
items.beschreibung: Two hours across the east-coast bays on your own machine, with a guide leading the route.
items.price_estimate: estimate: EUR 150-280 per ski per hour

items.name: Seabob & Parasailing, Ornos
items.beschreibung: Seabobs, wakeboard and a parasail tow from the calm side of the island, good with children aboard.

items.name: Supercar Hire, Convertible Grand Tourer
items.beschreibung: An open-top grand tourer delivered to the villa for the week, insurance and island drop-off included.

items.name: Mini Moke Island Hire
items.beschreibung: The island's own runabout — open-sided, easy to park in Chora, and the only sane car for the back roads.

items.name: Mykonos Airport & Port Chauffeur
items.beschreibung: Private Mercedes V-Class with an English-speaking driver, meeting guests at the aircraft steps or ferry ramp.

items.name: Athens to Mykonos Helicopter
items.beschreibung: A forty-minute private hop from Athens instead of the ferry or the airport queue.

items.name: Villa Hurmuses, Agios Lazaros
items.beschreibung: A cliff-edge estate over Psarou with infinity pool, staff and the island's best-known private sunset terrace.
items.price_estimate: estimate: EUR 8,000-25,000 per night in high season

items.name: Cliffside Villa, Aleomandra
items.beschreibung: A quieter west-coast house with its own bay access, for guests who want distance from Chora.

items.name: In-Villa Massage & Recovery
items.beschreibung: Two therapists to the villa with table, oils and a recovery protocol for the morning after.
items.price_estimate: estimate: EUR 180-320 per person per session

items.name: Hair & Make-up Before Dinner
items.beschreibung: A stylist to the villa in the hour before you leave, so nobody loses the evening to a salon.

items.name: Private Chef, Aegean Table
items.beschreibung: A chef and one server for a long table at the villa: whole fish, island cheeses, everything cleared before midnight.

items.name: Beach Picnic, Fokos
items.beschreibung: A set table on an empty north-coast beach, driven in with shade, ice and a cooked lunch.

items.name: Delos Private Guide
items.beschreibung: The archaeological site with a licensed guide and a private boat, before the midday crossings arrive.

items.name: Ano Mera Village Walk
items.beschreibung: The monastery, the square and the butchers of the inland village — the island the beach clubs never show.

items.name: Blue Marlin Ibiza
items.beschreibung: Cala Jondal's flagship day club, where the DJ programme and the yacht tenders arrive together.
items.price_estimate: estimate: EUR 200-400 per person, bed minimum spend applies

items.name: Nikki Beach Ibiza
items.beschreibung: White beds and Sunday-brunch theatrics on Santa Eulalia's quieter east coast.

items.name: Beachouse Ibiza
items.beschreibung: A relaxed Playa d'en Bossa terrace that works as the daytime warm-up before the big rooms open.

items.name: Experimental Beach
items.beschreibung: A small salt-flats terrace near Ses Salines built around cocktails and the sunset, not the party.

items.name: Casa Jondal
items.beschreibung: Barefoot beachfront dining on Cala Jondal with grilled fish priced by the kilo and a serious wine list.

items.name: Sa Punta
items.beschreibung: A Talamanca terrace looking straight back at the illuminated Dalt Vila walls after dark.

items.name: Ushuaia Ibiza
items.beschreibung: An open-air poolside arena in Playa d'en Bossa where the headline sets run in daylight and finish by midnight.
items.price_estimate: estimate: EUR 80-150 entry, tables from EUR 2,000

items.name: Hi Ibiza
items.beschreibung: The island's most technically equipped club, directly opposite Ushuaia and built for the after.
items.price_estimate: estimate: EUR 70-120 entry, tables from EUR 2,500

items.name: Pacha Ibiza
items.beschreibung: The original cherry-logo room by the marina, running since 1973 and still the safest late booking.
items.price_estimate: estimate: EUR 60-100 entry, tables from EUR 1,500

items.name: Pacha Table & Bottle Service
items.beschreibung: A booth above the floor with a host, bottles waiting and no queue at any point in the night.
items.price_estimate: estimate: tables from EUR 1,500, magnum service from EUR 800

items.name: Ushuaia Poolside Table
items.beschreibung: A daybed table at the pool's edge for the headline set, with service through the afternoon.

items.name: Formentera Day Charter
items.beschreibung: A crewed crossing to the sandbanks of Illetes with a beach lunch booked ashore.
items.price_estimate: estimate: EUR 3,000-8,000 per day for the boat

items.name: Es Vedra Sunset Cruise
items.beschreibung: A smaller boat around the west coast for the hour the rock turns gold, drinks aboard.

items.name: Jet Ski Tour to Es Vedra
items.beschreibung: A guided run down the west coast to the rock and back, two hours on the water.
items.price_estimate: estimate: EUR 160-300 per ski per hour

items.name: Seabob & Wakeboard, Talamanca
items.beschreibung: Flat water on the town side of the island for wakeboard sets and seabobs, kit and instructor included.

items.name: Supercar Hire, Open-Top Sports Car
items.beschreibung: A convertible delivered to the villa, the right car for the drive to the north of the island.

items.name: Four-Wheel Drive for the North
items.beschreibung: A practical car for the dirt tracks down to Cala d'en Serra and the Benirras road.

items.name: Ibiza Airport Chauffeur
items.beschreibung: Private car and driver from IBZ to any villa or hotel on the island, with meet-and-greet inside the terminal.

items.name: Ibiza to Formentera Helicopter
items.beschreibung: Ten minutes across the strait instead of the ferry queue in August.

items.name: Atzaro Estate, Sant Llorenc
items.beschreibung: An orange-grove agroturismo estate inland, the calm counterweight to a week on the south coast.
items.price_estimate: estimate: EUR 1,200-6,000 per night depending on the house

items.name: Cliffside Villa, Cala Jondal
items.beschreibung: A modern house above the bay, walking distance from Blue Marlin and Casa Jondal.

items.name: In-Villa Massage & Yoga
items.beschreibung: A therapist and a teacher to the villa: a morning session on the terrace, treatments in the afternoon.
items.price_estimate: estimate: EUR 150-300 per person per session

items.name: Hair & Make-up Before Dinner
items.beschreibung: A stylist to the villa before you leave, timed to the table booking rather than the salon's diary.

items.name: Private Chef, Balearic Table
items.beschreibung: A chef at the villa for a long dinner outdoors, with the market run done in the morning.

items.name: Paella on the Terrace
items.beschreibung: A rice cooked over wood at the villa in the afternoon, which is how the island actually eats.

items.name: Dalt Vila Private Walk
items.beschreibung: The walled old town with a guide in the cool of the morning, ending at the cathedral terrace.

items.name: Wine Tasting, Sant Mateu
items.beschreibung: The island's own small vineyards inland, tasted with lunch and a driver waiting.

items.name: Le Club 55
items.beschreibung: The Pampelonne original from 1955, wooden tables under the pines and a lunch service that ends when it ends.

items.name: Loulou Ramatuelle
items.beschreibung: A refined Pampelonne room where the Riviera crowd goes when Club 55 feels too crowded.

items.name: Nikki Beach Saint-Tropez
items.beschreibung: The loudest bed on the bay, running its signature afternoon party through the season.

items.name: Verde Beach
items.beschreibung: A Mediterranean-Levantine kitchen on Pampelonne with live acts moving through the tables at sunset.

items.name: La Vague d'Or, Cheval Blanc
items.beschreibung: The three-star table at Cheval Blanc, the most formal dinner available in the bay and booked weeks out.

items.name: L'Opera Saint-Tropez
items.beschreibung: Dinner-show dining behind the port that slides into a dancing-on-the-banquettes finish.

items.name: Le Girelier
items.beschreibung: A straightforward grilled-fish and bouillabaisse address on the old port, front row to the yacht parade.

items.name: Les Caves du Roy
items.beschreibung: The Byblos basement, unchanged in spirit since the sixties and still the hardest door in town.
items.price_estimate: estimate: tables from EUR 2,000, no meaningful walk-in

items.name: VIP Room Saint-Tropez
items.beschreibung: A portside club built entirely around table service and the people watching it.

items.name: Les Caves du Roy Table & Bottle Service
items.beschreibung: The only reliable way through that door: a named table, a host, and bottles on the ice when you arrive.
items.price_estimate: estimate: tables from EUR 2,000, magnum service from EUR 1,200

items.name: Byblos Terrace Table
items.beschreibung: A held table on the hotel terrace for the hours before the basement opens.

items.name: Gulf of Saint-Tropez Charter
items.beschreibung: A crewed day along the Pampelonne coast with a tender drop directly at the beach clubs.
items.price_estimate: estimate: EUR 3,500-9,000 per day for the boat

items.name: Pampelonne Tender Day
items.beschreibung: A smaller day boat with a skipper, enough to swim off Cap Camarat and be dropped at lunch.

items.name: Jet Ski along Pampelonne
items.beschreibung: An hour or two off the bay with a guide, launched from the beach club you are already at.
items.price_estimate: estimate: EUR 180-320 per ski per hour

items.name: Seabob & Wakeboard, Canoubiers
items.beschreibung: Flat morning water in the bay for wakeboard and seabob sessions, kit and boat included.

items.name: Supercar Hire, Convertible
items.beschreibung: An open car for the corniche to Ramatuelle, delivered to the villa or the port.

items.name: Classic Mehari Hire
items.beschreibung: The Riviera's own beach car, which is more useful in Saint-Tropez traffic than anything faster.

items.name: Nice Cote d'Azur Chauffeur & Helicopter
items.beschreibung: Either a two-hour chauffeured run from NCE or a twenty-minute helicopter hop to La Mole.
items.price_estimate: estimate: EUR 350-600 by car, EUR 2,500-4,000 by helicopter

items.name: Saint-Tropez Port Chauffeur
items.beschreibung: A car and driver on call for the evening, which solves the one problem the town cannot: parking.

items.name: La Reserve Ramatuelle Villas
items.beschreibung: Hillside villas above the bay with hotel service, a spa and complete separation from the port traffic.

items.name: Villa in Les Parcs de Saint-Tropez
items.beschreibung: A gated estate minutes from the port with pool, staff and its own beach path.

items.name: In-Villa Massage & Recovery
items.beschreibung: Therapists to the villa with table and oils, booked for the morning after the late table.
items.price_estimate: estimate: EUR 200-350 per person per session

items.name: Hair & Make-up Before Dinner
items.beschreibung: A stylist at the villa in the hour before dinner, rather than a salon appointment across town.

items.name: Private Chef, Provencal Table
items.beschreibung: A chef at the villa for dinner under the pines: local fish, vegetables from the market, rosé throughout.

items.name: Vineyard Lunch at the Villa
items.beschreibung: A long lunch at the house built around one estate's wines, with the winemaker pouring.

items.name: Rose Tasting, Chateau Leoube
items.beschreibung: An organic estate along the coast for the tasting that explains why the whole region drinks pink.

items.name: Old Town & Place des Lices Market
items.beschreibung: The Tuesday and Saturday market with a guide, before the town fills after eleven.
